_provenance: Walls-only conversion of the existing bigbang objective. Removed all maximize/minimize. The human judges the survivors.
name: bigbang
description: Grow a solar system from a seeded gas cloud. Kepler's third law must emerge from the grown orbits — it is never coded.
walls: Period MUST scale as radius^1.5 across the WORST restart (kepler_r2_worst >= 0.90)
The fitted Kepler exponent MUST land in [1.3, 1.7] (kepler_slope_mean)
Every restart MUST produce at least 3 bound, orbiting planets (n_planets_worst >= 3)
At least 90% of total mass MUST collapse to the central body (central_frac_mean >= 0.90)
Planets must carry at least 0.1% of system mass (planet_mass_frac_worst >= 0.001)
Late mergers MUST be rare — at most 2 (merges_late_worst <= 2)
Orbital inclination RMS must stay under 15 degrees (incl_rms_deg_mean <= 15.0)
Angular momentum MUST be conserved: L_z drift under 5% (lz_drift_worst <= 0.05)
At most 15% of mass may escape the system (escaped_frac_worst <= 0.15)

output.format: star_mass_frac + planet triples (m_rel, a, e) per system
output.what_passes: For each planet: relative mass, semi-major axis (AU), eccentricity
